title: Week of Aug 17–23 · Emma's Kickoff
subtitle: Welcome, Emma! You kicked things off today with a 4-mile run. Log it below, then your first strength session is Saturday.
goals: Log today's 4-mile run (time, effort, and how the IT band felt). Day 1 is in the books
One strength session Saturday. Start light, form first: Back Squat at your 65 lb, RPE 6–7, a couple reps in the tank
Start the hip + glute work. Small moves now are what keep the IT band happy as your running builds
Sunday easy: gentle yoga or stretch. Your first full 5-day week starts Monday
One-time setup: connect Strava at workoutplanning-production.up.railway.app/api/strava/connect/emma so your runs and heart rate show up here automatically
review: Welcome to your plan! Your 8 weeks point at two things: getting stronger and becoming a better runner, with Yoga Sculpt staying in the mix because you love it. This weekend is a kickoff, and your first full week (Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Sat evenings, ~60 min) starts Monday. One honest note on today: 4 miles is a big day against a ~6 mile week, so the next couple of runs stay short and easy on purpose. Because the IT band aches during and after runs right now, the first 2–3 weeks keep runs short (1.5–2.5 mi), lean on the bike for extra cardio (every run card has a 🚴 swap), and put a heavy dose of glute and hip strength on every lifting day. Stronger hips + patient volume is the standard fix for IT band trouble, and your Yoga Sculpt classes count as plan days, so total volume stays sane. Lifting starts from what you know: Back Squat at 65 lb, RPE 6–7, and we progress from whatever you log. On the 138 → 135 goal: muscle first, scale second. Light nutrition tip to start: since snacking is the main pattern, anchor a protein source at each meal (aim roughly 100g+ per day) and keep easy snacks visible, e.g. Greek yogurt, fruit, jerky. Log everything, even one line on how it felt. Next week builds from what you actually did.

items.focus: Brace, chest tall, knees track over toes, squat to a depth you control. Leave 2–3 reps in the tank.

items.note: Pick a weight that's RPE 6–7. Push-ups any time as a sub.
items.focus: Shoulder blades set, lower under control, press up and slightly together.

items.note: Light to start. This is a hinge, not a squat.
items.focus: Soft knees, hips back, feel the hamstrings, flat back the whole way.
Flat back, pull to your hip, squeeze the shoulder blade.
Slow and controlled, toes forward, don't let the hip roll back. This is your IT band insurance.
Drive through the heel, hips level, squeeze at the top.
